items.title: Concurrency Was HARD Until I Learned These 16 Concepts: From Hardware & Threads to Distributed Systems
items.description: Master engineering guide to the 16 core concurrency concepts: Processes vs Threads, Race Conditions, Mutexes, Deadlocks (Coffman), CAS, Thread Pools (Little's Law), Event Loops, Database Pessimistic/Optimistic Locks, Distributed Locks, and Fencing Tokens.

items.title: On-Us Transaction Processing — Internal Clearing, Ledger Deadlocks & Card Bypass
items.description: Comprehensive senior architectural guide to on-us transaction mechanics, direct ledger book transfers, lexicographical lock ordering to prevent deadlocks, cross-shard 2PC, and card scheme bypass routing.

items.title: Synchronization & Deadlocks
items.description: Race conditions, critical sections, mutexes, semaphores, monitors, classic synchronization problems, deadlock detection/prevention, and Java concurrency utilities.
